*Finding Equilibrium: Two Economists on Higher Ed's Future* is a weekly, data-driven newsletter on the future of higher education. [Read and subscribe on Substack →](https://findingequilibriumfuturehighered.substack.com/)

Each project has its own page with the posts it supports, the data behind them, and interactive tools.
